description: This file defines an enumeration 'ExecApprovalCommandDisplaySanitizer' providing utility functions to sanitize strings by escaping invisible or format characters, primarily for display purposes.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input string by escaping invisible or formatting Unicode characters.

methods.name: shouldEscape
methods.description: Determines if a Unicode scalar should be escaped based on its properties and presence in the invisibleCodePoints set.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Converts a Unicode scalar into its escaped string representation in the format '\u{hexadecimal}'.
